values.note: Fairgrounds camping $30 a night, by board motion as of May 1, 2024; the same for an extra night during the fair.

fees.source: https://www.rosscountyfair.com/rentals/index.html ('Fairgrounds Camping | $30.00 per night | (per motion: 4-12-24 as of May 1, 2024) | The same rate applies for extra night of camping during the fair.'), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: Cleared: rested only on Harvest Hosts / AdventureGenie / RV Life via the note. The fair's own pages state no hookups; Campendium and Allstays list 30/50 amp but are directories. Read 2026-10-31

booking.source: Cleared: rested only on the note's 'Call ahead'. The fair's pages give no booking method for camping beyond rental contact (740) 775-5083. Read 2026-10-31

note: Ross County Agricultural Society. Fair-week camping runs on a move list and a wait list; call ahead for other dates. --Claude
summary: Fees added at $30 (own rental rates); the note's ~$20 was wrong. Hookups and booking cleared: only directories support them. Note cleaned.
flags: ASK: the fair's own site confirms campgrounds 'available for rental throughout the year' and $30 a night, but states neither hookups nor how a non-fair camper books. Inclusion rests on Harvest Hosts + AdventureGenie/RV Life ('open spring/summer/fall to public transiently'). Campendium and Allstays: about 200 sites, 30/50 amp; no rate, no water/sewer. Needs a call to (740) 775-5083 (hookups, whether a single transient RV can stay outside fair week), like Elbert/Jackson County.
Note's '~$20/night' and inclusion evidence's '~$25/night' are both superseded by the $30 rate of May 1, 2024.
Long-stay: the 'Fair Camping Move List' and 'Wait List' for 2027 show fair-week spots are held by returning campers; other weeks unaffected as far as published.
Events on the grounds (Chillitown MX, Trade Days, Jeep Fest, Swap) may fill it; nothing published on camping during them.

Pin on the fair buildings, about 430 m from the middle of the camping rows south of the racetrack: about 39.4047,-83.0025 (read from imagery; no site coordinates published). Scioto River is about 550 m north of the buildings; 'not waterfront' stands.
